segments.contextAfter: `content`: A compositor content builder that defines the content for each instance of the immersive space. The closure receives a binding to the value that you pass to the [`openImmersiveSpace`](environmentvalues/openimmersivespace.md) action when you call that action to open an immersive space. The system automatically persists and restores the value of this binding during state restoration.
